title: Work on the Hearts and Minds of Others
coreMove: Win cooperation by touching what people feel and value before you demand compliance
sourcePressure: Chapter 43 centers on durable influence that works through emotional buy-in rather than fear or blunt coercion alone. The law argues that power lasts longer when it reaches hearts and minds, because people resist less and cooperate more deeply when they feel understood, persuaded, or invested. Its limit is that this should not collapse into manipulative sentimentality or vague kindness detached from real leverage. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
